parameters.query:
SELECT
    requested.id AS requested_anomaly_id,
    a.id AS anomaly_id,
    a.symbol,
    a.anomaly_type,
    a.severity,
    a.status AS current_status,
    a.acknowledged_at,
    a.resolved_at,
    a.resolution_reason,
    a.detected_at
FROM (
    SELECT $1::bigint AS id
) AS requested
LEFT JOIN anomalies AS a
    ON a.id = requested.id;

parameters.query:
WITH request AS (
    SELECT
        $1::bigint AS anomaly_id,
        $2::text AS expected_status,
        $3::text AS target_status,
        NULLIF($4::text, '__NO_RESOLUTION_REASON__') AS resolution_reason,
        $5::text AS action,
        $6::text AS workflow_name,
        $7::text AS execution_id
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE anomalies AS a
    SET
        status = r.target_status,

        acknowledged_at = CASE
            WHEN r.target_status = 'acknowledged'
                THEN COALESCE(a.acknowledged_at, NOW())
            ELSE a.acknowledged_at
        END,

        resolved_at = CASE
            WHEN r.target_status = 'resolved'
                THEN NOW()
            ELSE a.resolved_at
        END,

        resolution_reason = CASE
            WHEN r.target_status = 'resolved'
                THEN r.resolution_reason
            ELSE a.resolution_reason
        END

    FROM request AS r

    WHERE a.id = r.anomaly_id
      AND a.status = r.expected_status

    RETURNING
        a.id,
        a.symbol,
        a.anomaly_type,
        a.severity,
        a.status,
        a.acknowledged_at,
        a.resolved_at,
        a.resolution_reason
),
audited AS (
    INSERT INTO anomaly_lifecycle_events (
        anomaly_id,
        action,
        from_status,
        to_status,
        resolution_reason,
        workflow_name,
        execution_id
    )
    SELECT
        u.id,
        r.action,
        r.expected_status,
        r.target_status,
        CASE
            WHEN r.action = 'resolve'
                THEN r.resolution_reason
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        r.workflow_name,
        r.execution_id
    FROM request AS r
    JOIN updated AS u
        ON TRUE
    RETURNING
        id AS lifecycle_event_id,
        created_at AS lifecycle_event_created_at
)

SELECT
    r.anomaly_id AS requested_anomaly_id,
    r.expected_status,
    r.target_status,
    (u.id IS NOT NULL) AS transition_applied,
    u.id AS anomaly_id,
    u.symbol,
    u.anomaly_type,
    u.severity,
    u.status,
    u.acknowledged_at,
    u.resolved_at,
    u.resolution_reason,
    ev.lifecycle_event_id,
    ev.lifecycle_event_created_at
FROM request AS r
LEFT JOIN updated AS u
    ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN audited AS ev
    ON TRUE;
